@typescript-eslint/no-deprecated.why: tsgolint skips the signature check on self-closing JSX, so a component deprecated only through the component it wraps (MenuItem) goes unreported; config/oxlint/noDeprecatedSelfClosingJsx.mjs stands in. typescript/no-deprecated stays on for this file, so the day tsgolint reports these itself the run fails on an unclaimed finding and the stand-in can go
